data.text: The SoA described below should be followed for all participants enrolled in Study AMCD. However, for those participants whose participation in this study is affected by exceptional circumstances, such as pandemics or natural disasters, please refer to Section 10.16 for additional guidance. If clinically warranted, an unscheduled visit may occur per investigator discretion.

data.text: The complete physical examination excludes pelvic, rectal, and breast examinations, unless clinically indicated. All remaining physical examinations throughout the study should include a symptom-directed physical evaluation, as well as an examination of the heart, lungs, abdomen, neurological system, thyroid, and visual examination of the skin. See Section 8.2.1. Assess for TB risk factors, and for signs and symptoms of active TB, including exam of peripheral lymph nodes (see Sections 8.2.1 and 8.2.10).
data.sourceSection: SoA Table 1 - Complete physical examination comment

data.text: Perform as indicated based on participant status and standard of care. May be performed by a qualified personnel per local regulations. Every symptom-directed examination should also include an examination of the heart, lungs, abdomen, neurological system, thyroid, and visual examination of the skin. At least every third month after screening, assess for TB risk factors, and for signs and symptoms of active TB, including an assessment of peripheral lymph nodes (Sections 8.2.1 and 8.2.10).

data.text: Participants who had a tuberculin skin test (TST) must have the test read 48 to 72 hours after placement. data.description: Protocol Amendment (e) electronically signed and approved by Lilly on 04 Nov 2025 GMT. Substantial amendment incorporating regulatory feedback including replacement of 'mucosal healing' with 'histologic-endoscopic mucosal improvement plus absence of neutrophils', SoA corrections, gallbladder disease risk addition, exploratory endpoint correction, inclusion/exclusion criteria updates, ECG exclusion criterion addition, continued access details, mMS appendix update per FDA Guidance 2016, and other clarifications.
Protocol Amendment d approved on 10-Sep-2025.
Protocol Amendment c approved on 08-Aug-2025.
Protocol Amendment b approved on 31-Jul-2025.
Protocol Amendment a approved on 17-Apr-2025.

Original Protocol approved on 04-Feb-2025. Protocol Number I6T-MC-AMCD. Phase 3b study of mirikizumab (LY3074828) and tirzepatide (LY3298176) in adult participants with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis and obesity or overweight. IND: 174802; EU trial number: 2024-520209-38-00. Document ID: VV-CLIN-168867.
